Hey you want to get angry? Some rough maths:

Anthropic IPO: $1.3 trillion
Anthropic copyright settlement: $1.5 billion

If Anthropic paid $150,000 per title like they should have instead of $3,000, the settlement would be $75 billion.

After that, the company would only be worth… $1.225 trillion.

value.text: Should have been $150k per title, as per copyright law. Should have put Anthropic out of business. Should have given authors adequate compensation to focus on their art.

I can't speak for others, but to think I'd have accepted ~$3k (really, $1500! maybe! I don't know!) to just... give my story to the plagiarism machine for all of eternity is absurd. So what we're getting for this is essentially a scattering of birdseed and a punch in the mouth for our trouble.
